title: Keep the primary checkout's main current automatically (sync-only, never switches branches)
goal: The primary checkout sits on main but only moves when park-primary.sh runs (worktree creation), so it drifts behind origin/main (4 commits behind an hour after parking). Add 'park-primary.sh --sync-only': fast-forward the primary checkout's main to origin/main only when it is already on main, clean and has no local commits; otherwise do nothing and say nothing. Never switch a branch, never touch a dirty tree. Call it from 'susi workflow check' and the session-start hook so it stays current with no one thinking about it. Tests sync_only_* against real temp repos, plus one through the susi binary.
